reviews.text: Tried the rest, came back to the best. Simple, stable, and most of all, it respects the file system as my organizational system, it doesn’t want me to create a “library” or a “vault” and work within that. It just lets me edit text files on my system. I wish it were prettier and I could tweak a few visual things, but I’d much rather live with the utilitarian design that works than enjoy an aesthetic app where I can’t find anything I saved. (Looking at a certain blue and white, opinionated app from a Japanese design firm.)
match obsidian folder. 可以找到obsidian的文件夹。不错！

GREAT APP. This is the smoothest and most beautiful Markdown editor I've ever seen, and its support for WebDAV is simply perfect! Does the author have any plans to continue updating it? For example, could it be adapted to the latest iOS and iPadOS 26?

Fantastic little markdown editor. Rock solid, reliable, affordable, and still maintained without feature bloat. Strong integration with the Files app, and it respects my font preferences in Settings. Its flexible organizational features make it an excellent repository for plain text notes of all kinds, regardless of their extension or what app I produced them in.
Great. No frills or clutter, fast, stable for years. Excellent app that does what it says.

Best iOS markdown editor with Dropbox support, hands down. Upgrading to iOS 26 broke Dropbox support. I use this app every day and was devastated by the interruption to my daily workflow. Seeing that it hadn’t had any updates for roughly 3 years, I didn’t have much hope and started seeking out alternatives. iA Writer is what I landed on. While it’s an impressive app with some great features and polish, it was missing the ability to manually refresh files from Dropbox and the dark theme & font combo felt inferior. After several days of using the new app, the developer of 1Writer released an update that fixed Dropbox support in iOS 26 and restored my daily workflow. Thank you so much for the quick bug fix. It was a no-brainer to give the developer a $20 tip using the Tip Jar feature in the Settings screen.
Really glad to see updates again. This was one of the most useful tools on my iPad and iPhone. Glad to see it being updated again

Used to work great, but i can no longer edit any files over WebDAV. Used to work great, but i can no longer edit any files over WebDAV after updating to iOS 26. 5 star app otherwise, but useless until gets fixed.

EDIT: Thank you to the developer for fixing the bug! Five stars.
Dropbox support no longer working with iOS 26. Please fix 🙏

reviews.text:
WebDAV is so smooth. While WebDAV is present if you don’t use it at install it is hard to find. In general navigation isn’t as intuitive as aiWriter, and it isn’t as feature rich… that said it is more affordable.

Still, with offline storage, WebDAV has a lot of value with a local Nextcloud install. The creator should be advertising this more. I use this with Obsidian on computer as I don’t want to pay to for Obsidian sync.

Buggy. The editor generally works great. But the current version when interfacing with Dropbox keeps crashing especially when switching files or directories. Very disappointing. Pretty much unusable on my phone.

reviews.text: My most-used app. I can edit all my text files on iCloud from my phone! Powerful and reliable. Love it. The JavaScript actions are handy, too.

Really nice app. Wish it could print in color. I like this app a lot. Only limitation I see is that I cannot export the same view as in the render mode. It always prints black and white. If it had color export or print this would be five star all the way. Still a nice app for reviewing, just need to be able to print and email a pdf in color.
No CriticMarkup. Arguably the best part of MultiMarkdown, and it doesn't work.

Almost Perfect. I love the app. A few suggestions follow. 

It's missing Markdown's "==" syntax for highlighting text, as well as the corresponding toolbar button. (HTML <mark> tags work though.) 

Like other reviewers, I wish it had toolbar buttons to select the current line and to move the current or selected lines up or down. A button to select the current word and then expand the selection to the current sentence and then the current line would be stellar. Same with buttons to expand or contract the current selection by one line (up or down).

It would also be nice to have regex search across files and regex find/replace within the current file. 

In general the app is solid although I've noticed hiccups on recent iOS updates. I generally wish the app received more frequent bug fixes and new features. Other than that, I've been using it for years and it's my nvALT substitute on my phone.

rock solid. Surprised to see that this app was updated two years ago… There's no sign that it is aging at all. This is the only markdown app that I have ever used for writing stories that hasn't revealed some quirky incompatibility with my process. I love it.
Would not open my markdown files. Bought this for one job and it failed. Do not buy!

Works great for my use case. I did a lot of research for this. I wanted a markdown editor with preview that can sync between devices especially with Dropbox for no subscription. I also wanted to be able to readily share stuff as a nice-looking PDF. This syncs great for me. I get to use this as an editor without being locked in for a sync vendor. Makes my life a lot easier. Thanks!
Found this and enjoying it. I use 1Writer to begin my markdown writing journey and then moving the file to obsidian to link my thoughts and notes. Works flawlessly.

1Writer has replaced SimpleNote for me. I am a longtime SimpleNote user because of its library features and cross platform support, but have become increasingly dissatisfied with it not having a toolbar on iOS and now dealing with CAPTCHA on Windows. I played with several Markdown editors, but they didn’t have the library features I needed. Then I discovered 1Writer. It’s nearly perfect and the price is right. I still use a couple of apps for occasional PC use, but 1Writer maintains my library now.
Classic. Great app. Does what it says for the price you pay. Like they used to be. Whippersnappers!
Perfect. The perfect writing app. Big fan of its Dropbox-connection support. Powerful where you need it, simple and elegant everywhere else. All software should be like this.

Over a decade later, still great. I first downloaded 1Writer over a decade ago, and still use it on a weekly basis. It keeps everything I write synced to my Nextcloud server via WebDAV and support markdown formatting. Love it.

Many thanks to the developer for continuing to support it for so long!

Best writing app I’ve ever used.. This app is fantastic. One of its best features is how it will remember where you last left the cursor in a document when you open another. You can swipe out of a draft and come back to it right where you left off. This and being able to organize everything into files has made it one of my most used apps because of how easy it makes writing.

Nextcloud powered notes syncing!. I self host Nextcloud and I can use the WebDAV syncing to point at the notes folder on my server. And now I can use the same notes everywhere without relying on a proprietary syncing service or iCloud. 

This is what I’ve been looking for to pair with Typora for iOS/Mac/Linux notes taking bliss!

A daily driver! Please keep it up!. This app is awesome and i use it every day to write rust code and llm prompts on my phone while not at my computer. I love the backtick button, it helps me a lot. here are some ideas to improve the app: 1. Can you please help us benefit from 1Writer on Apple Watch by making complications and a watch app to record on the go? That would be really great for cases where you’re running without your phone and just want to take a quick note. 2. Minor issue: in night mode, the search box text is still dark, so you can’t see what you’re typing in the search box at night. Could you invert the search box text color to white if the night mode is on? 3. (Maybe too hard) How could we connect our GitHub accounts to 1Writer and essentially use this app as an IDE? 4. Can we please please have horizontal lines? They don’t seem to work because the first 2 dashes ligature and then the third dash doesn’t make a markdown hline.
I use it for many years. Great app
This app does markdown editing right. There are million ways to create markdown editor, but only few ways to make it right. This app is one done right.

Does not support Google Drive. The documentation was unclear, and I wanted to save the next person some time: as of now this app is incompatible with files stored in Google Drive. I have Google Drive linked with my local (iOS) file system, and 1Writer even recognizes that directory exists, but it will not access Google Drive. 

If this behavior changes, I’m sure this app would be perfect for my needs!

Still handy, still gr8ly used!. Luv this app. Runs w/o bugs and handles all my txt doc needs so I am not tied to Apple notes app. I sync w/ free version of Dropbox. Using it for >3 yrs. Perfect! 

#RECOMMENDED 
iOS 16 on iPhone 14 & iPad mini 6

Very useful app but buggy for me since 4/2023. I've been using 1Writer as an iOS mobile companion to Zettelkasten's The Archive app on 2 Macs for plain-text database syncing in iCloud. [Prior to using The Archive on Mac, I was using nvUltra and before that, nvAlt / Notational Velocity. And originally my database was in Dropbox but there were some issues having the database on Dropbox on the Mac before I started using The Archive.]

I've been mostly very satisfied with 1Writer. My 1 reservation is that starting in April 2023, and recurring regularly (at least once a week?), 1Writer on iPhone (but not on iPad, but I use it less often in iPad) loses its connection to my database folder in iCloud. When this happens, I need to add it back to the Folders screen (by tapping Add Folder button and choosing the iCloud option) and then set my database folder again as the default folder (by going to Settings > Default Folder.)

The developer was very responsive in quickly giving me this fix. (Deleting and reinstalling 1Writer also fixes the problem for the moment.) But it's getting frustrating to have to do this so often. There hasn't been an update for 11 months...

Top of the stack. A better mobile notes app doesn't exist. What I love:

- Extra keyboard row
- Notes import
- Dark mode
- Simplicity

Worth $5. I can edit my documents directly in Dropbox, iCloud or OneDrive while I’m away from my computer and have time to work on them. My changes are immediately synced. It’s an incredible benefit for working on articles, notes and code. It’s definitely a developer’s assistant.
Print doesn’t print images. Even though the images are correctly linked and viewing in the preview, when printing the images are not printed and instead replaced with question mark placeholders.

Nice editor, but could use some support for org files. I really like the features and design of this app. One downside is my files are formatted in the org format. Full text search does not work with them, even though they are just text files. Some support for org rendering would also be nice.
Awesome. Searched for so many markdown editors that I could link to my NAS. This is by far the best with integration that works and user interface!

Works for my needs. My needs are a simple text message editor that can handle larger files, which it does really well. You can also dive into some extended, cool functionality if you need to. 
[This appears to be fixed now]
My only negative would be that while the editor is open and I’m editing a file, if I rotate the phone (usually by accident) and rotate it back the app hangs for a couple seconds then crashes. I’ve never lost data from this happening, so it’s a minor annoyance. 

It’s been a very reliable app for my needs for years. I highly recommend it.

Currently my favorite simple markdown editor. It’s a simple app that gets the job done, integrates well with iCloud and Dropbox, and doesn’t crash (unlike some prominent non-free editors I’ve tried). Currently my go-to markdown editor even though I have a paid subscription to a competing app. One complaint: I don’t see a way to increase the font size for easier viewing. Also, while there may be a feature to create footnotes/endnotes, I haven’t seen it.
Excellent app. This is the only app I’ve found that works well enough for note taking in plain text and syncs via Dropbox so I can use vscode for my notetaking on pc.
Live edit missing. Great app with ton of features but I don’t know how or why developer missed live editor like many other apps. It’s a must have on phone. No one wants to toggle anymore.

All around stellar app: my go to. I used Editorial for many years and though I tried many other writing and note taking apps before and after that, 1Writer is the one I use every day and trust the most with my writing and notes. Another app worth a look in this space is the new app Tot from Icon Factory which is a fun, simpler take with similarly high standards. But 1Writer is far more powerful and flexible, and allows me to use iCloud to edit my notes on the Mac in my preferred text editor which is usually Sublime Text these days. Having access to the raw files in a normal filesystem matters to me, and 1Writer strikes the perfect balance for me of being quick to capture an idea with sane, customizable defaults, and fully featured enough to go back and find then edit that idea later. The switch between editing and previewing markdown can be quirky to get used to but it's handled well here. Plus the in-app browser experience was recently simplified to great benefit. It's nice to see the app keep improving so considerably and steadily.

Clean and Powerful. 1Writer has become my “go-to” application for my notes repository domain. Being a fan of markdown, I enjoy this app’s ability to both create and easily view md formatted notes. 
It also provides an easy to use “file system” that allows me to structure and array of documents. 
The real power behind 1Writer, however, are it’s URL Scheme and JavaScript action libraries. You can create your own actions and/or choose from a series of actions that others have created and shared. From a simple note-taking applicator to a diverse document repository, it’s hard to beat this app.

Excellent app, replacement for permanote. Just started using 1Writer and I find the interface great and customizability of the actions and extended keyboard row to be fantastic. It was hard to find the settings for a while (have to swipe from left side of the screen). I also suggest searching the 1Writer actions directory website for easy actions to install and tweak. Really looking forward to using this.

I used to use Permanote, but when I upgraded my phone, I could not longer use the standalone version. The current Permanote version charges a subscription, and the price is just a bit too much for me for an app.

Developer Thought of Everything. I use this application to edit markdown notes stored in pCloud using WebDAV so everything syncs nicely with my computer. It’s a breeze to type, especially with the handy special characters keyboard.

The export function threw me for a loop at first because it defaulted to hard line breaks. I was just about to give up for another app when I found a setting just for line breaking. So glad to keep using my favorite app!
Excellent. Simple and intuitive. Keep up the great work.
Good Note App. Don’t Like Text Auto-formatting.. I like this app, but it does some auto-formatting that is annoying. I wish i could turn it off. I explored the setting and don’t see it as an option.

This App Is Awesome. I don’t use many of the advanced features, but they’re there and they work great. 

I use this mostly as a writing app for 5-6 years now I think. It’s never failed me and never crashed. 

I’m a dream interpreter, so use it mostly for writing dreams I’m the middle of the night. I dream a lot sso this is really important for me. The night mode is vital to me so I don’t wake up my wife with a bright screen after I’ve woken up to record something. 

I love this app. I’ve used many others and this one is a keeper. 

And I think its usability is really strong considering all the advanced things it can do for more advanced needs. It’s still a really simple UI. So that makes it great.

Nice Dropbox interface. The workflow for keeping files up to date on Dropbox is very nice.

It automatically returns on launch to the last Dropbox folder I had open. It auto uploads the changed files and keeps in sync.

Simole and effective, thanks!

Amazing Useful App. I use this App daily and find it extremely useful. It's my go-to App for all text writing.

I love the way you can set up folders and subfolders - very helpful.

EDIT: I still love this App, but it has a flaw that drives me nuts. If I copy a link into a document, then go to touch the link (the plan being to use it in email or another document), I end up at the link location! Finally, it's almost impossible to exit back to the base App. (I tried to find an email to report this issue, but I might have missed it...)

Wonderful note-taking application. I wanted a simple note-taking app that worked with plain-text and would sync with Dropbox and 1Writer is perfect! 

I love the extended keyboard, which places markdown formatting at your fingertips.

File transclusion and wikilinks are a huge plus.

Works great for syncing with other plaintext editors on my (non-Apple) devices, like vim and obsidian.

Lots of handy little settings, like the ability to have a new note open on start and to pin notes to the notification center.

No a YAML header support yet but that’s no big deal.

Buy the app, it’s worth it!!!
Great app. I just started using this app and i love it so for its very easy to get around an its super solid not glitchs at all

Clean, Simple, and Dependable. After bouncing around the world of Markdown editors on iPad, I eventually began oscillating between iA Writer and 1Writer. iA has some nice features depending on your use case (better templating, typewriter mode, all that good stuff), but I would have weird issues with it at times. Its Dropbox support is already pretty wonky compared to most other apps, and eventually completely stopped working for me a couple months ago.

1Writer has been bullet-proof, though. It does exactly what it says, and does it well. There are small quality-of-life things like being able to close your current file without opening up another one. I don't know why, but it's just nice to be able to do that.

It's been easy to use, and I even poked around in their Javascript tools to create a small action that copies my current Markdown document, and opens up my blog CMS so I can "export" it to Wordpress. Not as clean as iA, but gets the job done. I recommend it as a really good place for anyone to get started with Markdown on their iOS devices.
Simple and Works. Tried them all and this is the simplest one that works

Clean app, solid syncing, fast bug fixes. Really appreciate the clean design and solid Dropbox sync implementation. Perfect solution for editing text files across iPhones and iPads! I e-mailed support when iPadOS 15 caused the Dropbox link to periodically vanish, and an updated version of the app was available to download less than 24 hours later. Haven't seen the bug since. Outstanding!
Works nicely with Dropbox. 1Writer is a very nice application for working with text files, and it works nicely with Dropbox.

Won’t stay synced to Dropbox. The app worked great for me on iPad and my previous iPhone X. Installed on new iPhone 12 and it syncs to Dropbox great at first but within a day it loses the folder and reverts to /Documents locally and I can’t navigate back to Dropbox folders. Have to uninstall and reinstall but the problem keeps recurring.
Would love to see TOC. My favorite iPad OS editor. Would still love to see TOC or outline ability, but honestly just great.
It’s worthy. A great application for editing markdown files which sync with iCloud

Great Tool, Okay Editor. I would recommend 1Writer for anyone trying to manage a Zettelkasten system on the go. It has a unique set of features (quick links, files app support, etc) that make it the best tool for that task.

If the editor had syntax highlighting, and if word wrap respected indentation, this would be 5 stars in a heartbeat.
(Maybe I’m missing a setting for word wrap somehere?)
Still excellent!. I’d love to see more themes and typewriter scrolling, but regardless this is my go-to markdown editor.

Best markdown app ever. This is the markdown app of my dreams. 1) doesn’t use the dumb iOS files interface, 2) loads a whole Dropbox folder, 3) links between files with [[link]] syntax, 4) Nice keyboard accessory, 5) URL SCHEMES (do stuff from Siri Shortcuts), 6) JAVASCRIPT ACTIONS!

Thank you for this, seriously ❤️
All you need on your cell phone as writing app.. Easy to use. Copy and paste to other apps. Well organized.
I use this to capture content for Obsidian.. Works perfectly with my iPhone and iPad. Very happy!
Robust. I like how robust this app is. Makes it incredibly more useful.

Best so far, wish I could “select line.”. I’m a writer and I’ve been through a number of text editors for iOS. When my last favorite one wilted and died due to lack of support, I set out to find a really good one. Various sources steered me to 1Writer, and I discovered I’d already bought it in the past but never used it. I reinstalled it, set it up to sync with Dropbox, and have been happy ever since. My previous text editors would often not allow me to create new files unless I was online or had a data signal (because I had them set to sync with Dropbox), but 1Writer doesn’t give me that trouble. 

The one thing I really miss from my last, now dead, text editor was the option to “select line” when you touch and hold and get the usual “select” and “select all” options. Often, it would be convenient to select a line or paragraph without having to drag the beginning and ending markers hither & yon using a touch screen. So pleeeeeeeeease add that, okay? Thanks!
TERRIFIC. Full featured and fantastic. I use 1Writer all day for a variety of purposes and I regret nothing! Great for power users or simple needs alike.
Great app. It works well. Very bare bones, but stable and syncs well across devices. Wish we had a MAC version for the laptop though.
Not reliable. Sync issues, buggy.

reviews.text: The best mobile companion for Obsidian. Since Obsidian doesn't have a mobile app yet, this is the best app to sync it together via Dropbox.
My go to text app. Excellent Dropbox syncing and javascript automation lift this text editor out of the pack and make it my go-to text tool on iOs.

Excellent Markdown editor. This app has many well-thought out options and an intuitive design. It works well not only as a markdown editor, but also has search functionality that is useful for managing many documents.

The only perfect plain-text writer. This is the only Dropbox-syncing markdown and plain-text writing app I've found that does what I need it to. Works great for anything from notes to novels. Everybody should get this! Keep up the fantastic work!
Wonderfully simple, aesthetically delightful text editor. This is my preferred text editor on iPad because of its superb balance of simplicity, elegance and minimal design. Highly recommended.

Piped Links!. The recent addition of piped links [[document|display text]] is valuable and appreciated. It’s compatible with the personal wiki project Obsidian. 

An improvement I would like: autocomplete suggestions for pre-existing file names typed after double brackets.
Solid .md editor. With obsidian.MD this is a nice addition. The design is very well done and low friction.

Best Obsidian MD Mobile. Obsidian MD is the greatest program ever, but it had no great mobile equivalent - until I found 1Writer. 1Writer has a favorites section just like Obsidian, so it makes it very easy to navigate my top notes. The just released update support pipes for note aliasing, so 1Writer just gets better over time.

Big Fan. I’ve used 1Writer on my iOS devices for years to manage my recipes and to access the nvAlt files I create on my MacOS devices. It is one of the few must have applications for me. Highly recommended.
My choice for editing my simple markdown Zettelkasten on iOS.. The only good option IMHO for getting into Dropbox files and working on files modified in obsidian.
Excellent.. Simple, elegant , functional

Such a great app!. I have switched all of my note taking over to using markdown files and I use 1Writer for both my iPhone and my iPad. I love 1Writer and do recommend it. I do however wish they supported Google Drive sync and had an app for Android, but other than those two things I have no complaints.

One app to rule them all. Not often you see a devloper who sticks with his app and upgrades it. This app keeps getting better. It has replaced my all notes app (simple formatting). UI is great and app never crashes and its fast! Developer is also very nice and helpful. Check out his other app for to-dos :)

I love this app. It is quick, very stable, fast and reliable sync with Dropbox and iCloud. It has beatuful writing options and markdown editor. 
Tags are great! 
Again if you need a GREAT text and notes app get this one! I have tried over 50 of them and I'm glad I boght this one. 
 
Oh and I love the color! Dunno why but it makes me productive and concentrated! 
It has everything and it looks great! Works as my whole note database!
-------------

This app continues ti be amazing!
No support for Google drive. Can’t sync files I have in Google drive. Not useful without it.
Works great with Obsidian + Dropbox. Love it. Links work properly and images render. Woohoo!
As close to perfect as you can get. This is everything I was looking for in a markdown editor. Would love to see additional themes/Home Screen icons in the future, even if they’re paid.
iPadOS 14. 2021 and no update for iPadOS 14. How?
Best Cross Platform Sync for Windows. Using VS Code as a notes editor on Windows and Mac with 1writer on iOS is the best note taking experience, hands down!

Great tool for markdown. I came to 1Writer looking for a tool to edit my markdown files (as part of an Obsidian vault). It gives me all the right tools I need to be able to work quickly in my database fo md files and the interface gives me everything I need to make the process fast. it is a great plain text editor!

Excellent Markdown App - Some Suggestions. I love this app. Navigation is great, it supports [[backlinking]], ![embeds](), and #tags like a champ. I use Obsidian with iCloud and this pulls in all of my files with ease. My favorite feature is the customizable markdown extended keyboard, which makes writing in markdown even simpler. 

However, I do have suggestions:

• Backlinks between folders - 1Writer has a difficult time recognizing backlinks between sub folders within the root folder. For example, if I have a link to [[1 Peter]] in my current note located in “/Personal/Daily Notes” it will not identify the document “1 Peter.md” located in “/Personal/Books”

• Enhanced Shortcuts Integration - So far, the only action one can take with Shortcuts is “Open with 1 Writer.” An option to “Create New Note with (variable)” or “Save file in (specified folder)” would be incredible. This would make it easy to create multiple notes with Shortcuts and automatically save them to the appropriate folder. Currently I have a workaround that saves a .txt file in a /shortcuts folder in iCloud that I have to rename to .md and open with 1Writer. 

• iCloud folder access aside from /iCloud/1Writer - I have my Obsidian vault saved in /iCloud Drive/1Writer and it works fine, but using additional apps can be difficult. Setting up root folders outside of /1Writer would be nice. 

• Additional Themes/WYSIWYG/Easier-to-reach Preview button - these are much lower level suggestions, but additional themes, a “what you see is what you get” style processing, or simply an extended keyboard button to toggle preview mode/moving the preview button to the bottom of the screen are simple QOL changes. 

That said, AMAZING!

Simple and Clean but Buggy. It’s okay the Dropbox integration works way better than Editorial. JavaScript actions are a nice touch. But the paste bug is really obnoxious after you paste with an external keyboard, you lose all cursor control. Plus, the down arrow (again, external keyboard) sometimes moves to the end of the document with no modifier pressed. I dunno...I just expect better from a paid program than some random external keyboard bugs.

Needs better file navigation. This seems really well done. Unfortunately it lacks the ability to navigate back when you’ve followed a link to another file. This makes it very difficult to work with a large set of notes. I hope the developer will consider implementing this!

Great app that I can’t continue using. I hate when people take stars off a review for an app not having a feature that fits there specific needs so I didn’t. 1Writer is perfect in every regard. 

But, I need an editor that syncs with Google drive and that isn’t 1Writer. Hopefully in the future it will be.

Great app for markdown editing. App is great, supports almost all markdown features, good editing experience, Dropbox sync works as expected. Hashtag and link navigation is also good, however it doesn’t support wiki links with alternative text (like [[Link|Text]] which I use extensively - hope it will be implemented soon.
YAY :-). Still the best ios text editor money can buy.

Really appreciate this for Zettelkasten. Hope more features are added overtime (like creating custom shortcuts for each of the actions maybe!?)

One of my main issues with this app is not being able to see the whole title of your notes. So please fix this first. Everyone who uses this for ZK notes complains about this and I imagine it would be a relatively easy fix. 

Would be nice also if you could open links in the side window like Bear which makes it easy to flip through the links in a note to quickly take a look at them. FWI in Bear the right window stays put when you click links and the left window opens the link. In 1Writer when you click a link you leave the page you’re on even if you have two windows open.

AWESOME. Hands down the best markdown iPad/iOS editor I’ve used... has everything I need and is extremely portable. Integrates extremely well with my workflow between zettlr on my pc + iCloud Drive... looks like this should integrate very well with zettlr or other markdown workflow on multiple platforms!

Particularly needed the wiki style links + image support with relative paths... very pleased to be using 1Writer!

Buggy, bad UX, and no support. Don’t expect to get an answer from support. My iCloud folder is gone and can’t add it back. OneDrive doesn’t work. Lots of bugs and no answer to support tickets. Don’t waste your money.

Perfection. Just the right amount of features while still being spry.

Flawless syncing. Great “default file name” builder. Fast.

Humble feature request: More options in Workflows. eg “New Document in X” folder.

Warning: doesn’t work with OneDrive or Google Drive. I bought this because I expected it to work with OneDrive and Google Drive through connection to the iOS Files app. Most other apps can connect to any cloud storage supported by Files, and many people online were claiming that 1Writer would also support OneDrive and Google Drive. I guess nobody actually tested it out, because when you add those as locations to Files and try to select them, they are grayed out in the 1Writer app. Nowhere on the app description, website, or help did I see that this app does NOT support other cloud storage. Unfortunately this is not something you can find out until after you pay for the app, and you can’t get a refund. I contacted the developer for support and have yet to hear back after a few days.

Exactly what I needed. Dropbox support is seamless. Editor is good looking. Supports [[wikilink]] syntax. The in-app browser is something I didn’t know I needed, but I’d sure useful.

The only think preventing this from being the perfect app for me is the ability to change the search engine in the in-app browser from google to DuckDuckGo

All-round great writing app. A wonderful app for working on text/markdown files. Syncing with Dropbox, it feels seamless to switch back and forth between writing on PC and on phone.

As some of my notes are somewhat long and divided by several headings, I'd love to see an activatable toggle/fold option (in edit mode) for hiding content of headings and even for bullet points. This would help me navigate long notes and keep writing space cleaner. But this is extra, this really is an all-round great writing app.

Great app with one problem. This is a good app. The problem is with the interface. The round, red buttons in the bottom corners (for new note and “...”) are very hard to touch. Usually I try to touch them multiple times before I succeed, and every time I fail the keyboard pops up and I have to make it go down again. Very annoying. I’ve never had this problem hitting buttons in other notes apps. I hope this can be fixed soon.
Really good!. Only request I have is I wish the default folder can be a folder exposed by Working Copy.
Pictures Don’t Upload. I unfortunately can’t upload any pictures to my notes, and I believe being able to is crucial. Please fix this problem.
No longer opens. Loved this app. Still use it on the iPhone. Now the app crashes every time I open it on a few year old iPad. Updates have not fixed the problem.

reviews.text: Normally 5 Stars, but.... Ok. I gave this app 5 stars because it truly is incredible and deserves 5 stars ... normally. You see, 1Writer has been an essential component in my trusted Drafts / nvALT / Dropbox note system for years. BUT, if it weren't for our long-standing relationship, I'd knock it down to 4 stars. Why? At some point in the last year or so, the app stopped being able to handle my notes folder: It crashes (every time, without fail) after just a handful of insignificant edits to any given note. Devs, please fix! 1Writer is one of the best in class, and I don't want to have to migrate to an alternative!

Love this app, exactly what I was looking for. I tried other apps like Editorial, which are great but seem to be lacking development and updates recently. Also I wanted something I could integrate with my Nextcloud instance which runs locally (no internet / cloud). I had used Joplin for a long time, which essentially uses WebDAV, as 1Writer does, but I hate the way I can’t use my own file naming and folder structure. This is important because I use VS Code a lot on Mac and PC, so I need to be able to create files there in Markdown.

1Writer seems to fit the bill nicely. I haven’t tried other cloud storage options (I.e. Dropbox), but WebDAV works nicely. It even handles images very well, so I can very easily insert an image, and link it to my /Images directory.

I hope this app continues to get more features and attention as it really deserves the 5 stars. I would love to see:

1. Split screen (markdown / preview) as I use an iPad Pro this would look great. I don’t like having to click Preview each time. Markdown Inline preview is enabled, but not sure what this does.
2. Some focus on privacy. I think it has this already, but an emphasis that 1Writer has no access to data would go a long way.
3. Add a WebDAV Sync button at the top.

Overall, amazing work!

I use this app a lot. But over the past year ive noticed files that are not synced properly dont even show up in the folder as if they are not there. They are not grayed out or disabled, they just don’t appear. I dont think this is right.
I love this app!. This app does what it’s supposed to do. It’s very reliable and easy to use. Support is fantastic! Much appreciated!
No code block highlighting. What about code block highlighting ?

My Favorite Markdown App on iOS. 1. Fast Sync with Dropbox
2. Support Zettelkasten (wiki-style link)
3. Fast and Clever Search Engine
4. Good performance

Even my iPhone 6s can cope with the 4000+ notes!

My go to Plain text editor. If you work in plain text and want to keep your work out if proprietary software, then I’ve found nothing better than 1Writer. It integrates perfectly with my Mac Markdown workflow.

My favorite writing app. I’ve tried maybe a dozen writing apps on iOS, and this is the only one that’s stuck for me. It has exactly everything I need, and nothing I don’t. It doesn’t make ludicrous claims about how it’ll enhance your productivity, and it doesn’t force you into convoluted workflows. It’s just a good place to type, and focus, and you can see your word count. It’s perfect.
My writing keeps disappearing. I love the app - until the things I write keep disappearing. I write something. Save it. Make sure it’s still there. And then a few weeks later it’s gone.

reviews.text: Nice but No Reliable Sync. The interface is lovely, but I wanted only a reliable means to edit and sync DropBox plain text notes. This app fails miserably in doing that: unreliable sync, creates duplicates, deletes files randomly. This issue has been reported for years. Developer apparently doesn’t care though. Enjoy at your own risk.

reviews.text:
A must have!. This app is one of the best out there. Simple yet customizable. It does pretty much everything I need without charging me a monthly or yearly fee like some other apps out there.

I only have two small requests. First is that I would like to be able to customize the line length. I’m using an iPad Pro, 12.9” screen and the app leaves a lot of white space on the sides. If I could choose the line length (size of the margins) that would make this app even better. 

Lastly, please add the ability to export as an RTF file.
Good text editor. This works well with Dropbox and the iPhone Files app. It opens txt files in place and does not make unwanted duplicates.

One of the best apps I've ever depended on. 1Writer does a great job. I sync a couple folders of plaintext notes between my iPhone and my Mac, and it does an awesome seamless job of this, while also supporting Notational Velocity-like fulltext search, as well as markdown preview, customizable JavaScript actions, a quick action keyboard bar... it really is spectacular. And has never charged for an update yet. Really spectacular work.

Great app. I've spend about $100 on various code/text editors. My search is over! I use exclusively for text. I do have a couple of suggestions: 1-add an option to go to beginning of file when it opens and 2-add an option to keep the left navigation menu always visible.
Excellent. Love the power features
Simply the best. I love this app.

Love this App!. I was given a $40 Apple Gift card for my birthday and after thinking about it I decided to use that money to find the best for me general purpose text and Markdown editor app. Using some ratings web sites I bought the top 5 apps which included 1Writer. I liked all 5 but 1Writer stood heads and shoulders above the rest in my opinion.

I like it so much I'll be sending the balance of that gift card as a tip right after I submit this review.

Consistently the best flat file notes editor. This has been one of my most used iOS apps for years. If you’re a believer in efficient flat text notes and love markdown, this app is a solid win. 

My only complaint is that there is no Android version, as the platform desperately needs such a clean and elegant solution and I fear the day I can no longer find new iPhone SEs :’(
Super useful efficient app. This app is perfect for my use case: managing notes as markdown files that sync with Dropbox. Excellent at what it does. Highly recommend.

Excellent App. This is one of the best apps I have ever used and guess what: I don’t have to pay for a stupid subscription! It’s a one time price - like an app should be. It’s better than Bear and you don’t have to pay for a subscription. And it does all I need it to do. It’s simple and works great. I use it for all of my note taking and writing. You can organize your notes with folders and with hashtags and that works great for me.
Fantastic. Extensible.. Great app. Simple to get started. Extensible enough via JavaScript for pro custom uses.

1Writer -. Searching for a Markdown editor that could render various flavors of Markdown and output to both PDF and HTML, I installed 1Writer on my iPad.

Cut to the chase it’s not for me.

1Writer feels half-baked. UI is unintuitive. Various controls are scattered about the corners of the screen signaled by uninformative icons. But the most irritating deal breaker search as I may I could not find a way to import items from the iPad notes application or any other source for that matter.
Better than Bear. Bear is the new big player, but this app still feels and performs better for me.
Great Markdown Text Editor. I really enjoy using 1Writer, I use it almost daily to write my personal journal. It’s interface is easy to use and its edit/preview mode is a nice touch.

Great editor, BUT .... Great Markdown editor and I’m enjoying it a lot.

BUT: There seems to be no way to choose a default iCloud folder other than just /Documents.

I keep all my blog posts in a subfolder. With 1Writer, I must first create the blog post, then rename it (which I eventually figured out, since there’s no menu option to “Save” or “Save As ...”), then exit the editor and use the File Manager to move it manually to the blog posts folder. Then I can re-open it in 1Writer and finish writing it.

It’s not enough to stop using the app, but it’s a nuisance.

One of the few left that syncs with Dropbox. Thanks for still syncing with Dropbox. Other apps used to synch with third parties but for some reason most are iCloud only. I use an iPhone and a windows laptop so finding apps that work across both is a pain sometimes. 1Writer allows me to write and see my notes on my iPhone while still allowing me to use my windows machine to edit and write as well. Finally the tag support is top notch here and I can navigate/view my tags here in the app and on my laptop so I’m very happy. Thanks to you developers working on this app.

Best app for plain text editing. Last decade I began to separate content from style as a CSS + HTML based website designer. I normally write all content as plain text, then import and style as appropriate for web, print, etc. My file structure is mainly plain text files organized by client and project into folders.

1Writer is ideal for working this way. I can quickly browse and edit cloud-based files on the iPad, then do likewise on the Mac using a standard text editor and Finder. Sync between platforms has been working well for me. I prefer this paradigm to other text editing apps that bundle multiple documents into a single large package.

The 1Writer interface is thoughtfully designed, uncluttered and stable. Markup is a welcome bonus at times that I use it.

Best plain-text iOS app. Tried them all. 1Writer is the best. 

Simple interface that stays out of your way. Custom keyboard row and actions/scripts add tons of functionality. 

Cloud sync always works great. 

Excellent mobile companion to the nvALT app on macOS.

Almost There. Closest iOS app to Typora. I wish I could default to the iCloud folder of another application of my choosing, automatically save images to a subfolder of my choosing, choose to see images inline, etc.

I would like to like this. The interface is great. The app is easy to use. But the Dropbox integration is broken, it has eaten my work twice, and it's not going to get a third try. If/when this gets fixed, I'd happily give the app five stars.

Great! One thing I’d like to see. This app really provides a distraction free, easily comprehensible writing environment. I use it for everything from chapter drafts to blog posts to research notes. That being said I’d like to see support for the triple dash line divide that I’ve seen in other markdown apps and the ability to leave spaces at the beginning of a paragraph(not talking about tab indentation, just to be clear.) I don’t have much issue with the existing app. It works perfectly well, but I would easily give 5 stars if it had a few more formatting options!

Great for productivity. Love this app, as all programmers love to use markdown for note taking! 
It would be better if we could have color highlight for code blocks. I personally would like to have this feature even if I have to purchase it.

Best Update Ever. - inline images
- edit text of multiple file types
- download and preview any file type IOS supports

Still elegant and simple.

This is the best of all of the note-taking/text apps. 
The cognoscenti bloggers love Bear. But, Bear uses tags for organization. 1Writer uses folders on Dropbox. What this means is that 1Writer syncs with ANY text editor on Mac or PC. The other note/text apps require their own client on Mac or PC.

1Writer also offers an excellent URL Scheme so it is as programmable as any other editor among those that do not have an embedded scripting language, which is overkill unless you are looking for a time-waster instead of an app for getting work done.

Having tried every credible text app, several of which are good, 1Writer is the best.

Good and can be better. 1. When I press `edit` button in preview mode, it shows the section where I was in edit mode. In most cases, I want to edit what I am previewing. So It would be convenient & reasonable to show the `edit` section same with preview mode. And vice versa. Please update the sync of page between two modes.

2. In iPhone XR, With bluetooth keyboard connected and landscape mode, it is very hard to scroll the bottom tool button by finger because it enables the home button action of iPhone XR, Please add the right and left arrow to allow the scroll of tool button by tapping it.

By far the best app for writing. Dear developer, thanks for this amazing creation. there are few user experience enhancements need, in addition to script builder keyboard shortcut (think of javascript completion in the form of keywords icons).

please add syntax highlight support for javascript and other languages. , 
- Add a side button to control the screen in addition the right swap (typing mode/next to keyboard and normal mode, don’t hide keyboard after doing actions in typing mode), which in turn :
 - ease the access to app settings 
 - go back and forward between open documents
 - Make navigation of files more ergonomic 
 - add switcher action group (requires an ability for the user to create and customize action groups)
 - 
other suggestions:
- fix install of action from the app official website , it’s painful to have to copy paste code individually
- make maintaining user actions easier by providing a method to create actions from a js file.

hope this gets done soon, am a big support to this amazing application. love to see it evolve and grow as the best app for mobile editing. 
PS: external cloud support is a key feature

Better and Better. 1Writer is the best of several notes apps that I have tried as a mobile companion to NValt (Notational Velocity)on my Mac. But I had been looking around at different note apps hoping to find one that offered wiki style links, using paired square brackets, without success. But now that feature has come to 1Writer, so I don’t have to look elsewhere. Since that linking system works in NValt as well as 1Writer, I’ve basically got a plain-text database syncing between my Mac, my iPhone, and my iPad. Awesome!
Love 1Writer. Awesome Markdown editor, please add shortcuts support for open other so i can build a script to open a file from working copy

Please support One Drive!. Please please please support One Drive! This is all I want to use for a service. Is there also a way to support Bears markdown? I sometimes write there and would love for 1Writer to be able to read what Bear is telling it. Any way to write in preview mode if you don’t want to use markdown?
App keeps getting better. This app has gone grime being one of my markdown text editors to my primary text editor on my phone. They keep polishing it and adding features. I highly recommend it.

SammyDuck. 1Writer is perhaps the most versatile and dependable markdown editor in the App Store. Its track record, since its inception, has yet to be beat. 

The downloadable actions, which extend the feature set enormously, are indispensable, or one can create one’s own actions using Javascript. Its url scheme is first rate and allows it to connect well with other apps and services. I use this app for posting to my Wordpress site.

The UI is about as clean and clear as they get. This app is perfect for everything from blogging to novel writing, and it is remarkably bug-free. Dropbox syncing to specific folders is quite reliable.

One wish I’d voice: It would be great to manually sort all files and folders at every level. Though merging files is possible thru drag-and-drop, that could be facilitated a bit, I think.

You really can’t go wrong here.

I spend so much of my time in this app. It's just the right amount of features and zippiness. I love the full text search. 

Typing gets sluggish when text files get long which is frustrating. Fix that performance issue and it's 5 stars!
Great app for markdown notes. This app is really well done. Simple and quick. I take my notes and sync them using Dropbox.

It will not let you down.. This is the one folks. If you want to write, simply, sync with Dropbox, and keep track of it all, get 1Writer. It’s a fork of the venerable Plaintext. It’s great. I’ve been using it for years, through the os’s through the 6s, 7s, and 8s and now the Xs.
这钱花得值了. 非常好用，真的很喜欢
Best markdown editor. I use both iA writer and 1writer. I like both of them. But, I think that 1writer is a better choice if you were to write in a foreign language like Chinese.

Highly Recommended!. It’s basically perfect. I have it sync through Dropbox and use nvAlt on my laptop. I've tried probably 10 apps for note taking and for me this is the best. Keep up the great work. 

Only request is an option for draggable scroll bar.
Great text editor. My new go to for simple text editing with Dropbox integration. Search works great too. Thanks!

Excellent design for writing / editing Markdown.. Really enjoying the clean design and focus of this app. It’s made writing Markdown notes on my phone a joy. Also 1Writer’s Dark theme is slick.

A few things it could use:
- Ability to pin certain notes to the top-level menu.
- Set a zoom level for Preview.
- Browser should use Safari’s default search engine, seems to only use Google.
- Supported some kind of UML/flowchart Markdown.
- Fountain support would be a plus.
Love this app!. No greater tool for composing and editing text libraries
It's perfect!. After trying so many markdown editors in app store, I finally decide to use this one as my editor.

Remains awesome. Prior to getting this app, I had tried around 30 “mark down-capable, cloud-connected“ iPhone apps to integrate with many notes stored in many folders on dropbox.

I first tried Simplenote and some others, I think 2011-ish, because I was unhappy with Evernote‘s lock-in of my text notes, and I had heard Merlin Mann and some other respected tech folks explain plaintext and markdown.

Over the years, some apps would work for a while, then not.

I switched to 1Writer in 2016 or 2017, and I liked the interface, the favorite folders, and the tag support. 

After having years of problems with apps not being able to handle dropbox synchronization without bogging down, crashing, duplicating data, etc., I was prepared for this app to eventually fail as well.

Good news for me it did not fail, and the synchronization has been amazingly good no crashes or duplicates, no need to restart the synchronization all the time.

Even if I don’t synchronize for a while, then go back into the app and rubber band to refresh, and then leave the app, when I return, everything is synced up nicely.

I have no time to write reviews, but my sense of gratitude for this great app compels me to share the goodness, so there you go :-)

1Writer + Dropbox + Sublime Text = 😃. This software engineer moved from Evernote -> Bear -> 1Writer. Nothing wrong with either of those, but I spend much of my day in Sublime and missed its power and convenience when working with notes. This combination works and 1Writer is a great markdown/Dropbox iOS editor.
Fantastic App!. This is a perfect compliment to nValt on the Mac. I am now able to search, add, and easily view notes from everywhere. Thank you for such a great tool.

Love this app, much cleaner than Drafts. In-place editing not ready yet.. Have been really enjoying this app so far. I started experimenting with TextExpander and one thing I would really like to see is better support like Drafts has. For example, when expanding a snippet with placeholders, Drafts actually opens up the TextExpander app so that you can fill in the placeholder and then returns to completed text to the Drafts app.

Also, trying to edit in place inside Dropbox seems to be buggy. It constantly tries to update the file while it's still open, which has caused me to lose some work. I haven't bothered with that since first trying it. I do appreciate the Dropbox integration. One thing I would like is the ability to create the new files inside a Dropbox folder of my choice so that they are available on all devices. What's the point of saving something locally? Maybe this feature is there and I just haven't found it yet. 

EDIT: thanks for the response. To clarify, I meant setting the default location of NEW files to Dropbox. In other words, having the new files when I open the app automatically save to Dropbox instead of to the device. 

EDIT 2: Well, this feature is already there. Never mind!! Thanks for the response once again.

Overall a five star app, improved TextExpander support would really make it nice for composing emails with templates and placeholders. Please add it!

The best out there for IPhone.. I bought this app the first week it was on the App Store and I’ve been using it almost daily since. It’s got all the features most would want and since it’s release it has been updated almost continually by the Dev. If it doesn’t have a feature you think you might need, wait a month and it probably will. It’s easy to use and has a robust filing system searchable by title, date, sub file, or hashtag. 
As I said, this is the best text editor currently available for IPhone . Well worth the price.
Excellent!. Excellent Markdown editor. I use this every day. Would love to see TaskPaper support added as well.
v2.8 deleted all my files. At least they're on Dropbox. On the other hand, it doesn't automatically download them. I have to click on each one to force a download, and I have thousands of notes.

reviews.text: Best Markdown Editor. I have fully switched to Markdown for all of my note taking, partially due to the existence of this app. The simplicity of the app is balanced with the right amount of configurability. Happy to have found it!

The *Best* Markdown App!. Thanks for the black theme and the multimarkdown support!!!

I'm happy to see a bunch of new press for this app. I've been using it for years and love its power and beauty!

This is by far my favorite Markdown editor. Byword is very popular, but 1Writer just blows it out if the water. It's incredibly aesthetically pleasing, and the developer is constantly refining it. 

This app has been on my home screen for years now!

Fantastic Customer Service. I originally downloaded this app as a replacement for Plaintext 2, who went out of business and stopped supporting the app. I had some issues with the .txt files I saved pulling up in other programs showing symbols instead of quotes. I shot an email to them when I was just about to give up, and quickly received a personalized response and fully detailed answer to my question (basically turn off Smart Quotes and Smart Dashes in 1Writers Settings).

Fantastic App
Awesome Customer Support

99% Perfect!. I got to say that after using and paying for Ulysses (two years), Textastic (a week), Editorial (few months), this app is exactly everything I ever looked for. The sync with Dropbox is amazing! I use 1Writer on the iPhone + iPad and then edit the .md files with TextMate on the Mac and everything syncs amazingly with zero conflicts.

Thanks again for creating this powerful tool!

Fits my needs. Does a great job performing the standard markdown notes app tasks. I’ve been looking for an editor that lets me perform a few more extended-like tasks like http requests and other javascript tasks and this works perfectly. Recommended.

Exactly what I needed. All I wanted was a full fledged markdown editor on an iPad that opened files I have saved on my iCloud Drive. This app now foots that bill exactly. I open an md file from Files, edit it in 1Writer, and its synced across my devices.

Great app, missing one key feature (wikilinks). Well designed and implemented, great for heavy text users (especially those hooked on nvAlt for the Mac and similar clones like nvPy.)

Dropbox sync works well, UI is designed for efficient use (but takes some getting used to.) excellent markdown support for both editing and viewing. 

If this app supported [[wikilinks]] for linking between notes it would be almost perfect.

Brilliant!. The ability to add custom actions via JavaScript is truly brilliant. Wonderful editor for markdown. Though it is perfectly adequate now, with the new file app changes coming in iOS 11, I would love to see a little more development with iCloud integration. Great app!
Great, flexible app. This is great for anything from quick notes to longer projects. And it's flexible in how it can plug into other apps you might use. Love it.
The best I've found. I've tried a ton of simple writing a note taking apps and I OS and this one best meets my needs, elegantly and simply.
Rated for 17+. I wanted to download this on my child's iPad but it was blocked due to a 17+ age rating. Had to install a competitors product.

Beautiful but not user friendly. Hashtag suggestions aren't working

Search doesn't show inline results and not helpful when you have multiple documents with same hashtags

Interface is somewhat cumbersome. Tapping the open note doesn't let you edit (like you'd expect)

Needs improvement. So much hype and it doesn't feel it lived up to it.

Love the app, but latest version has bugs.. The latest version isn't automatically saving files. Clicking on a created file (created from the app) in the directory throwa the error of "file not found", making you lose all your data in that note because saving to Dropbox ,haven't tested the others) isn't being done.

Works excellently with Dropbox. I purchased this app so that I could edit text files in Dropbox and it does that well and reliably. There is a slight learning curve in that you need to "add" a "folder" that you pick from Dropbox then it grays out some text files such as sql files, but you can click on those greyed out files and "edit them as a text file".

Fantastic Notes App. I just got this note app and I have already moved all of my notes into it. I think it has just the right balances of features and simplify and the design is gorgeous. I am glad to be rid of Evernote and Apple Notes for this. It seems to have the best aspects of every Notes app I have used. High recommendation.
Not for iPad Pro?. Swipe from left doesn't work on iPad Pro 9.7/10.1.

Excellent!. This text writing app will change your life! I love its night mode and extended keyboard. Very forward thinking. This app will increase your productivity exponentially! More app developers would do well to take a few lessons from 1Writer because this app takes every other text app to school!

Simply the best!. Hands down the best note taking app out there and I've tried plenty of them. 

Thank you to the developers for continually updating and making the app even better!

Doesn't sync to Dropbox. I bought this just to edit text files on Dropbox. I want to edit in place to keep sharing links accurate. However there doesn't seem to be any way to just edit in place. My edits aren't synced back. Bought Byword which works perfect. Disappointed I can't get my money back now.

reviews.text: My go to iOS text editor. 1Writer hits the sweet spot between elegant simplicity and a rich, customizable feature set. I've moved to an entirely Markdown-based notes system thanks to this wonderful app. Can't recommend enough.
Awesome app. I love 1Writer. So happy to see an update. My favorite writing app. A dock app for me.

Broken update -- Json errors. I was really loving this app until this new update. I get a JSON error with everything I do, so nothing's works. :-(

Hope they fix it soon!

reviews.text: Wonderdul update!. Thanks!

Cloud Sync Does Not Work. The main reason I went for 1Writer over another app was for Dropbox / iCloud Sync. Neither works as described. When you go to add Dropbox as a location to sync, it just opens the Dropbox app ... nothing else. Same happens with iCloud. I suppose this could be user error (me), or it could be my device (brand new iPad Pro 9.7 on 10.1.1). Couldn't find instructions to check if I am doing something wrong, though the interface seems pretty straight-forward. It just doesn't work as advertised.

Perfect Dropbox-compatible Markdown Editor. I was looking for a full-featured Dropbox compatible markdown editor for a long time and tried several apps in this category, but after reading a review about the new features of 1Writer, I decided to give this app a try.

Extended keyboard, check box option, real-time preview, Dropbox auto-sync, and an online repository for actions are just some of its advantages. The notification widget and sharing options are awesome and handy as well.

Although I was confused at first while I was trying to get the auto-sync feature to work, after a few minutes, I simply set up a Dropbox folder and now everything will be synced between all of my devices.

Deleted my entire Dropbox. I wanted to add a fodler for 1Writer in my Dropbox. I mistakenly put it in the wrong place, and when I deleted it, 1Writer deleted every file in my Dropbox except the new 1Writer folder that was now in the correct place. I've used so many apps that have connected to my Dropbox, not sure how these idiots couldn't have not had safeguards in place to prevent this.

reviews.text:
Superb for Markdown. My life runs on text files in Dropbox. For me, 1Writer is the ideal companion to nvALT for Mac OS X. As soon as I lock my phone after editing a file in 1Writer, Dropbox syncs it to my computer, where I can pick up in nvALT right where I left off in 1Writer. I wish Apple's native Handoff features worked that well.

The 1Writer actions directory is just icing on the cake. Check it out.

Promising but stuck in ancient Markdown. The program has promise, and was recommended by the creator of Permanote as a replacement when Permanote is discontinued. Unfortunately, for all its nice features (the in-app browser is very handy), 1writer doesn't support any recent markdown extensions like column spanning for table cells, footnotes, etc. As a result, documents that looked great in Permanote just don't translate. If the markdown support is brought up to 2016 levels, it will be a fine program.

Incorrect markdown rendering. If your markdown doc has a list with 3 levels of indentation, the third level is rendered the same as the second level. This is very confusing for markdown docs which are large deeply nested outlines.

TOPS!-Ulysses and iAWriter. I have tried Ulysses and iAWriter 
app and this is the best of them combined!!!!! Why?

1.Allows bullet points the other two appa iAWriter has BP but doesn't always work. Ulysses doesn't have that feature as far I can tell.

2.The night mode on this is beautiful and I love how cursor is red to stand out. 

3. OPTIONS!- Yes you can adjust line space and font size and style not just in edit mode but in preview.

4.Please come out with an Macbook Desktop App!!!!!!

Nice text/markdown editor, needs some additional features. I've tried almost all the text/markdown editors. I need access to my full Dropbox without a performance Meltdown. I used Nebulous Notes/ Permanote for quite a while, but was experiencing ongoing stability problems, crashes, slowdowns. Aesthetically, I prefer Editorial, Byword, and Ulysses, but none of them as far as I know allow access to the full Dropbox account, only a specified sub folder. 1Writer is pretty good. It can be slow to update folder/file listings, and there is no feedback, so app appears to have frozen or stalled, but it's just waiting to update the file listing. Be nice if this sped up, but at least provide user feedback that something is happening. Also, it really, really needs a recent files list, something that is fairly common in many other similar apps.

SIMPLY AMAZING.. I use this app every day. I loved drafts and byword both for different reasons, But 1Writer has become my ONE WRITER. It pretty much IS nvXX for iOS... i highly recommend this to anyone who loves markdown writers. This is DOPE.

THE Dropbox/file-based markdown, tagging Editor. This works for my nvalt, Dropbox, note-keeping system. Fast, converts snippets of rich text from the browser. The developer deserves all the accolade. It's so good that I only wish that I can find an equivalent program on my Mac, or that the developer would create the same App on the MacOS.

App-Filesystem as how stopper. The apps I use should not /must not dictate the way I organize my work. I should be able to open and save files in iCloud as I decide not as a sub-file or sub-folder in the app like 1Writer. Otherwise this is a nice app.

Best plain text writing app. I've been a fan of plain text writing for a long time and have tried more apps that I can remember. I always come back to 1Writer. It gets everything right: just the right about of keyboard shortcuts for Markdown, multiple Dropbox folder sync, just the right amount of syntax highlighting. The iPad Pro version is also very well done.

Shortcut-accessible search please! Perfect otherwise.. 1Writer is by far the most all-around flexible and pleasant app I've found for long-form writing. It beats out Editorial, Byword, Ulysses, and iA Writer because it alone has all of the following: 

1. A minimal, attractive, and customizable design
2. The ability to *only* view the document text
3. Dropbox integration *and* the ability to store *multiple* folders as shortcuts without having to navigate my entire Dropbox directory 

It does have other features I haven't so far found a use for, including extension capabilites that may or may not rival Editorial's depending on your needs. But the balance of functionality and minimalism is what really sets 1Writer apart. 

The competing apps either haven't been updated recently (Editorial's split-view update has evidently been delayed till the second coming of Elijah) or are arbitrarily locked down from certain things because of high-concept development directives (oh yes, iA Writer team, heaven forbid I suffer a distraction of 30 seconds to choose a non-fixed-width font). Editorial and Ulysses each have tools I continue to use, but neither is as well-suited for my needs.

The lack of a command-f keyboard "find" function is the only feature I really miss. You can get a search function from the action directory (which I'm sure I'd use more often if I didn't already have Editorial's), but a built-in search would be more convenient. But that's not a big enough complaint for me to conscionably remove a star.
Great Dropbox Notes Editor. Excellent app with lots of features. Easy to use. One suggestion: index Dropbox for full text search.

Perfect writing/note-taking app, especially for power users.. I'm an academic and I do all my note-taking and writing in plaintext/markdown. I've tried a lot of plantext/mardown editors over the years and 1Writer is *clearly* the best iOS plaintext/markdown editor.

It's perhaps not for everyone. If you're used to Simplenote/Evernote style applications, it can take a little time to adjust to a different file organization setup. But, to me, 1Writer is just as fast and clean as the simplest apps. Yet it also has tons of thoughtfully designed 'power user' features and through extensions, has infinite flexibility.

Excellent. I purchased *every* single editor in the App Store, as of 4/18/16. 

I use this one. It handles markdown much better than the rest.
Excellent for Dropbox + markdown. This app is the perfect companion to a Dropbox-synced plain text markdown workflow. I use this along with Drafts and am extremely happy with the combination.

Promising, but Dropbox sync is buggy. This app has the chance to be a major contender in the iOS writing space, but in my usage, I've found Dropbox sync to be really spotty. 

I've never lost data, but 1Writer consistently creates conflict documents, which makes me worry about versioning and document integrity. 

Otherwise, this is a really well-made app, and the experience of actual writing has been top notch. Fix the sync, and I'll be back.
Awesome. This editor is great. Easy to use and extensible. I only wish it had Seafile as a service.
Great app. It's nvALT for iOS!
Best. All the best features in a competitive app category.

Best Plain-Text/Markdown App Out There. I have tried most of the minimalist plain-text/ markdown apps available and this is by far the best. Before 1Writer I bounced back and forth between several apps, never able to find one that was quite right. I have been using 1Writer for at least a couple years and have yet to find another app that comes close in terms of functionality, ease of use, aesthetics and customer support.

Just right. I'm finding 1Writer sits in a sweet spot for my modest needs. It has enough features to do what I need and not so many that it's overwhelming. It has been solid and stable under iOS 8 and 9. It's extendable and has a reasonable number of useful enhancements that can be installed. Maybe not as many as some others but honestly I don't need a lot for what I do on an iPad. I do like that it doesn't impose a specific Dropbox folder but instead has access to any of my Dropbox folders. I had a UI question (related to using a Bluetooth keyboard instead of the iPad's keyboard) and got a prompt, truly helpful reply from the developer. I have two other iOS Markdown and text editors, but 1Writer is the one I'm reaching for first.
Simply gorgeous!. Simple & elegant markdown editor.

Useful. MathJax support?. All in all. If you write your papers in markdown this app will be very useful. A few things that I do think can be improved are, no MathJax / Tex support. Another is the confusing iCloud import. I haven't found a good way to simply import an iCloud document directly to the documents.

Crashes when I use the button to make a checklist. Please fix

This app is too expensive for sloppy crashes like this

reviews.text:
This is the 1.. I feel like I've downloaded (and bought!) nearly every writing, notes, and markdown app that is available for iOS. Sometimes I want something to take quick notes and with quick search to find them. Then I want something to compose longer material for articles or posts I write. And, of course, I want it all in the same app. Well, I do believe I've figured that out. It's 1Writer. It has a host of features that make it a great text and markdown editor, note taken and longform writer. Here are a few of the little details that I appreciate: 
- Lightning fast sync with Dropbox (and you can add any DB folder to the file list). 
- Lightning fast search in titles AND inside files.
- Offline use. 
- Quick new entry: the file name is prefilled with the Date and Time but is highlighted so you can change it if desired. 
- Helpful (customizable) toolbar with access to frequent functions. 
- Auto-Preview of markdown in reading mode. 
- A huge library of actions that can be installed (Post to Day One, search and highlight text in a file, jump to a section, and so many more.) Add what you need and none you don't.
- Universal app that works just as well on iPhone. 
- You can include pictures (auto-hosted and linked via Dropbox).
- Checklist formatting (with an Action to send items to common ToDo apps) is great for projects and listing items, checklists and tasks. 
- Built-in web browser

1Writer is an absolutely well designed app which is very simple and yet has tons of features. You don't often see an app that is capable of being both, but 1Writer is. Combine this with something like nvALT on your Mac (or Byword or iAWriter for longer writing) and you've got a fabulous text file solution. 

I'll also add that updates are frequent. It was just a few days after release that 1Writer got its iOS9 features. Excellent!

My new homescreen writing app. 1Writer is just great. From the big features right down to the small details. In-line Markdown preview without having to switch between modes is a great touch.

1Writer is worth it. Get it.

My iOS nv-Alt app. I live in nv-Alt on my Mac and 1Writer has become my psuedo nv-Alt app on iOS. The app's search features are great and and editing documents is a breeze. 

The only thing holding back that last star are some screen layout problems in landscape mode. Everything works great in portrait mode, but in landscape some of the screen gets cut off. 

Fix that and I'll be back to hand out that last star.
Perfect.. Simple and exactly what I wanted.

Requests. 1. Please obscure/blur the view when passcode is enabled and the app is backgrounded. The text can still be viewed in app switcher (double click home button) and briefly when returning to the app before the passcode screen appears. 

2. An iCloud option for syncing documents, folder structure, and settings across devices would be nice.
Best writing app. Even better than editorial if you don't need all the advanced things although this still has action scripts. Just wonderful.

Just buy it.. Problems with all my old markdown editors left me searching... Search ended with this. Everything about it is right. 

And the actions menu!? I no longer have to do multiple quick flicks to reach the bottom of the page, scroll to jump to a heading, or painfully manually search and replace. 

Great app!

Best app for Markdown+Dropbox, a delight to use. I have almost all the well-known apps for text and code editing. This is the most frictionless app for Markdown editing, and the Dropbox integration makes it a delight to use. I go to other apps for code editing (Koder, Textastic, new Coda), but whenever I will work on short and long text or markdown files, this is the only app I use. Highly recommended. I hope the developer continues to improve this already excellent app.

Awesome!. I really enjoy using this app! The in-app browser is a swipe away and makes it really easy to reference articles and other information while typing thing up!

Definitely recommend 1Writer!
Underrated gem. Get this, best editor with tags at the time of writing this review
My favorite iOS Markdown app. Fantastic app, easy to use and very well designed. Hope a Mac version is already in the pipeline.

Solid. I love markdown and am always taking my notes in markdown and syncing them with Dropbox. This app does both and handles them solidly. The app is stable and has enough options to configure it how you want it to. The app is still actively developed so it's been improving, definitely worth it.

Wildly exceeded my expectations.. I bought this app hoping for a solid Dropbox-compatible notes app with a clean, modern aesthetic.

1Writer is much more than I could have hoped. Syncing is fast and reliable, yes. The aesthetic is nice, yes. But the overall attention to detail here is astounding: the icons are descriptive and beautiful, the interactions make sense, customization is extensive but restrained, and file management is surprisingly solid. 

This app is highly recommended. It's just very well-designed and pleasant to use: I actually wrote this review in 1Writer.
Crash all the time. When I firstly using it, everything is OK. However, now it cannot work at all. I hope the developer can update it and fix the crashing problem as soon as possible.
