reviews.text:
Perfect for writing. Perfect for just writing. 

And the support is nearly unbievable. I was trying to figure out synching between devices and the author replied quickly over a weekend.

Surely one of the very best apps ever...and I only just heard about it in one of those "Top 10 Apps You Need" articles online.
My Favorite for Markdown. Great note taking app. Excellent MathJax support. Fast and nice export options.

Solid, clean interface, perfect. Like many of the rest of you, I've tried over a dozen iOS text editors in some inane Goldilocks-like quest for perfection. This one does what I want best: works well and stays out of the way. Just enough customization to make it behave in a way that suits my style so I can forget about it.

Best app for detailed/structured notes. If you use some rich text app like Evernote, you really should try this app instead.

Compared to other apps of its kind: best one, hands down. I've tried them all, including Editorial.

Compared to rich text notes apps, like Evernote: you really ought to try plain text with markdown instead. Takes getting used to, but worth it.
I love this app. I like it more than any other text editor or word processor on iOS.

Good App. I have been testing, playing with, and using 1writer for a day now. I must say that I really like it. However, I have found several bugs and have various gripes:

When using the extended keyboard to enter lists, if you 'return' to finish the list instead of deleting the final bullet or number, the list will automatically be continued later in the document. This can be seen when trying to enter another type of list, e.g a numbered list instead of bullet. In this instance the type will not change. 

We cannot change the name of the main Dropbox folder.

Overall this is a great app! If you're interested in an app that writes with markdown, this is perfect, I love it for notes and todo lists.

Perfect for note taking. It started with iA writer and then vesper and now I find myself in a weird world listening to MPU and buying expensive apps. Not that this is expensive. In fact, it's a perfectly reasonable price considering 1Writer is phenomenal. 

I haven't been happy with note taking apps since I've had an iPhone in various iterations since 2010. There are certain prerogatives that always causes a slight *kink* in the interface that prevented me from access. 

With a today extension, markdown preview, Dropbox support, Actions, various themes and TextExpander support, and everything else I need, this app is in my dock.

Half-Baked. This app does not synch with Dropbox. You have to use the awkward "actions" bar to upload each individual document to Dropbox. You cannot open a document from Dropbox but you can open a document from iCloud Drive. 

Good assortment of fonts and looks nice but this app feels like it was made 5 years ago.
Excellent.. Does everything I need and more: Replaces the now-defunct Elements app, syncs to Dropbox, highly customizable, and looks great. So happy to find this!
Great set of features. Makes an excellent notepad. I use it all the time and am very happy with it

BEST writing app by far.. I'm not BS'ing when I say that I literally tried almost all possible writer apps, and had to purchase them. None of them had the right look that I wanted, nor the right features. 1Writer is perfect, and looks amazing. It even has subfolders, which was the selling point. 

SUGGESTIONS: Please include more features like colored fonts and underline. Thank you.

Mad props. The author deserves huge kudos for producing a fantastic app. I've used it for about a week, and and had been reasonably impressed. And then I pasted some GFM-flavored markdown into a file on my desktop which was stored in iCloud and open in TextMate. After a few seconds, the file refreshed in 1Writer on my iPhone (no surprise) with code fencing and tables rendered beautifully (HUGE surprise). That, and the fact that it has the most usable keyboard accessory for Markdown that I've used, make this my new favorite app. Well played.

Ridiculously great!. My new primary text editor. My fav features are the hashtag tag list and inline markdown preview. 

Very responsive developer.

Absolutely wonderful app!!! Incredible job!

The best markdown editor for iOS!. I tried many other applications for editing markdown text files. This app is the best! Seamless dropbox syncronizing works great and reliable. Toolbar for markdown function is very convenient.
Image attachment is the best part of this app! It uploads the image files to Dropbox and make a public link for that! 
If there're something I need more, that is the stability. It crashed sometimes and it's very disappointing. And I want more elegant theme like ByWord.
Anyway 1Writer is the best for me.
Publish to Wordpress. Need publish to Wordpress feature!
The best markdown app for iPad. Only wish there was a Mac version available. The syncing between iPad and Mac is the one big advantage Byword has over 1writer.

The Best. A very well designed text editor. I finally found one I like after searching (and paying) for many others.
I really like the integration with Evernote and the ability to include tags.
Great job developer!
Works Great!. In my opinion, this app works better than iaWriter or Byword. I have had no problems with iCloud synching between my phone and iPad. Thanks developers.

Best plain text editor out there. I've tried iA Writer (Pro), simplenote, Upword, and many other plain text editors, and none of them compare in functionality or price. This is the best priced app for its functionality and its functionality is truly remarkable. Seriously. Smart keyboard shortcuts, ability to link to other docs, Dropbox, Evernote and iCloud support, super useful built-in browser...etc. I seriously can't believe how good this app is. Wish I could get my money back on iA writer...just hope the developer continues support.
Great Improvements. Another great update to one of the best Markdown editors around. Now with JavaScript actions. Has a simple, clean interface, and all the necessary features.

2ND TO NONE. The best note writing app ever. The layout is fantastic. There's nothing out there that even comes close to the ease of use and clean UI of 1writer. The features you want are right here, look no further.

Awesome notes app, keeps getting better!. 1Writer is an awesome Markdown editor that just keeps getting better and better. The inline Markdown preview, addition of checklists and universal iPad/iPhone availability make it ideal for my narrative-driven planning and organization style. However, I was pleasantly surprised, then blown away, by the addition of the integrated web browser, the elegant Today Screen and Safari integration, and 1Writer Actions! The developer, Ngoc Luu, is amazing -- super responsive and clearly focused on making 1Writer the best writing tool and writing experience. A Mac version of 1Writer would end my quest for the ideal writing toolkit.

still my favorite markdown editor. update 11/2014 : thanks so much for the new update. so many great features added and support for iPhone 6! the rest of my review still stands so read on 😄

Every update brings great new features to this app. I love that it's universal so I can add content from my phone when I'm on the go or my iPad when I'm at home. 

I mostly use the app to write up note sheets for a podcast I co-host. The check-box feature is invaluable to me as I can easily check off topics as I cover them. Worth the cost right there.

As far as this update is concerned, the in-line styles while editing is GREAT. So nice to see that now instead of having to save/preview. 

Thanks to the developer for continually giving us new features to an already superb app.
So well done. Such a well done app. Markdown preview, sharing to various services & now updated for iOS8 with sharing sheets. Easily one of my most used apps.
I like this app very much!. Simple and beautiful!
Look no further.... You’ve found the App Store’s best markdown / dropbox text editor. Period. I’ve tried them all and this one is practically perfect.

Ad Built In. The editor is alright, but every time you go to paste something there is a link to the Flesky keyboard, which I do not have installed and do not want to install. This is unacceptable. This is a paid app and there should not be an ad every time you copy paste, especially to an app that has seemingly no affiliation with this one.
Still the best note-taking/Markdown app. Still the best note-taking/Markdown app
Finally a great one. I've used IA Writer, Bywords and Write. Finally one which works great.
Image insertion uses dropbox http links.. I’ve been looking for something that will insert images with relative markdown links. I’ll have to keep looking.

One of my top 5 apps!. This application is a top productivity staple for me. Best text editor available. The keyboard and UI features alone place it above the competition - these features having been the main source of frustration in the other text editors I have tried. Some of my fav features (keep in mind this is simply a quick list):

* Markdown support and keyboard tools.
* Ability to insert hyperlink or picture at the click of a button, with pictures stored by link to Dropbox so as to not increase local storage on device.
* Ability to load folders from Dropbox and other cloud based locations for easy access to files stored from those locations. I can easily edit a document stored on Dropbox from multiple devices without worrying about syncing.
* URL scheme support - I love love love this. I have a few LCP actions that I use on a daily basis (ex: to append to lists), works flawlessly with 1Writer. 

Great application. $2.99 is more than worth it.

Strong Markdown Editor. Beautiful and intuitive to use. The only weakness I can see is that it does not support MultiMarkdown. Taskpaper support, a la Editorial, would make it trivial to use the two interchangeably, which would be handy.
Simply Galactic !. Tried other popular writing apps, which all failed my HIGH expectations. 1Writer takes the cake, gold medal AND blue ribbon !

Great writter App. LOVE APP!
I would love it to be for mac and also sync my notes, everything else ests great, thank you for this beautiful app
One of the best!. Very well done! Definitely recommend.

Yes!. I'm feeling like Gary Busey right now on that commercial: "Yessss!" 1writer finally has word count! This was the only reason I couldn't use this as my only writing app, because I needed word count for my project. Not anymore...Thank you!

Search no further, you found it!. I have paid for so many different note taking and text editing apps. I have finally found the one that has built in workflows that get the job done cleanly and quickly with flawless sync. 1Writer is the one.
Love it!. It's the best! Except I miss the white border around the logo. It looks incomplete without it.

The best, finally. Tried all the other note apps that sync with Dropbox and this is the best by far. The updates keep knocking it out of the park and continue to impress me. You can tell this dev cares and uses the app daily. You will not regret grabbing this one and syncing it up.
Best iOS text editor. Fantastic interface, and love the markdown inline preview. The icon is perfect now!
Italics and Bold. Gotta put a star before and after each section of text. If you add more text to a section of a document then all the text directly around it loses it's formatting

Perfect. Was looking for a great looking markdown editor with Dropbox support and this app blew me away. Great execution, wonderful keyboard additions, fast syncing, and even todo lists. 

Very well done.

Awesome dropbox plain text app!. This app is great. Fast, responsive, dynamic full-text search results. Some theming options. It displays markdown formatting as you are editing. It also auto detects URLs and phone numbers in notes and makes them tappable. Minimal and beautiful interface. Ability to take a photo with the camera from within a note and it gets auto uploaded to dropbox with the share link auto pasted into the note with markdown image formatting, all automatically. It also has x-callback-url support. The iPad interface is now similar to Mail.app which is perfect for a notes app.
The best Markdown + Dropbox note taking app on iOS!. Get it!

Great Dropbox editor. After PlainText switched hands, I had slowly stopped using text files in Dropbox. But 1Writer has changed that for me. Very solid and stable. I've never had any issues and I use it daily for note and journal writing. Keep up the good work!
It's now my go-to markdown app. It zoomed by all the others. It's that good.
Perfect App. Just download and use. Simple, easy, perfect.

Unbelievably good for the price. I have tried almost every top notch and decent editors, this is definitely the best value for money. I can't say it is best in every aspect but it's as good as anything apart from drafts and editorial.
The recent update brought inline markdown preview which isn't that common on iOS yet, and fixed the having-to-manually-save problem, making this a very competitive choice. 

Plus this one has a few vibrant but not blinding color scheme which is not that common either. They won't be good for long form writing but hey, not everyone who writes things down are writers.

I'd love to see it to add Dropbox versioning feature, but I consider this a great text editor as it is now, top five if you ask me.

Unless you already have too many text editors like I do, you don't even need to think before you buy this.
Great app, only getting better. Responsive developer, frequent updates, great feature set. After trying lots of other Dropbox-compatible text editors, this is undoubtedly my favorite.
👎. i can not Line Break !!!!!!

This app beats all competitors. Nebulous notes, notesy, WriteRoom, they ain't got nothing on this app. Support for tags! MarkDown preview on opening a file, like Day One and Trunk Notes, perfect for looking up a note and readably reading it. Only notes app to do this on iPhone as far as I know. Can't be beat. Just update TextExpander support please!

Almost ok!. Still needs polish. Seems buggy, like skipping to bottom too easily and wrong spacing. ux poor for sharing (multiple screens to do simple shares...duh). Still using it but little frustrations pile up!

Perfect note app.. Apart from having everything I needed in an app, it's especially refreshing when the app's developers contact you back right away. 

A+
No wonder it's 99 cents. It doesn't sync consistently w/Dropbox and not at all with iCloud. Another app hyped through false reviews. ia Writer is the real deal, this is bogus.

reviews.text: Picture system. Picture system doesn't work right find a new way

Really great Markdown app!. This is one absolutely phenomenal app. I switched to 1Writer because Daedalus, my original text editor hasn't been updated for iOS 7 yet, but I'm not not sure if I'll go back even when it is.

The URL actions offered by Drafts and Launch Center Pro are a huge part of my workflow, and I love how this can seep into that too. One request I have here is that I'd wish that we were able to make custom URL schemes, and if not that, at least the library was expanded more regularly. Also, it'd improve my workflow by a million times if the URL actions weren't two taps deep. Something like 'swipe to bring up actions' would be the best thing ever.

Regarding the app itself, I only have two little requests:
1.) I'd love more font options: Ubuntu and Ideal Sans are two of my favourites, and I'd love to be able to use them with 1Writer
2.) Font changes should apply to the viewer mode aswell. I don't really see the point of fancy fonts in the editor mode and not in the viewer. If I'd have to give custom fonts to either only, it'd definitely not be the editor.
Splendid. My favorite Markdown editor for iPhone. Great extended keyboard, well implemented tags and Dropbox support, and a nice level of customization. Excellent customer support as well.

Missing one critical feature. It only works with .txt, .md or .markdown files. I have some special text documents with different file extensions that I needed to work with. No luck. No ability to add more extensions. No way to know it had this limitation before buying.

Other than that, it looks great.
God is Good. real Great!!
No issues syncing on my iPhone. So I give this effective editor 5 stars...
doesn't sync. Hangs entering my Evernote Login on my iPad and gives me an arrow trying to enter login for iCloud.

reviews.text: Perfect writing app with Dropbox. This app has everything I care about in a writing app: full Dropbox navigation, Markdown support, and iOS 7 integration. Plus you can customize the colors and fonts in the app and easily view recently-edited documents. My new primary writing, editing, and task management app.

The missing link for Scrivener. Thank you, this wonderful app just ended a 2+ year search for an ideal mobile companion to Scrivener for the Mac. Could not be more thrilled! Nice work, blows away any other option for that purpose. And I've tried them all. I smiled once it was set up to my liking. :-)

Exactly what I was looking for. I haven't heard about this app from anyone, but stumbled across it in the store. What a fantastic app! It's exactly what I was looking for. Syncing via Dropbox, iCloud, and integration with Evernote are staples in any text editor, and this has it covered. A gorgeous design and the ability to change the default red color scheme are certainly welcome. The markdown parsing is great, AND the ability to create checkbox list entries anywhere in a document is unlike any other app I've used. Great work!

Pretty darned nice. Very nice looking and quick app, love Dropbox sharing and Evernote sharing. However, getting to the Evernote sharing function is a bit longwinded. The Evernote sharing option needs to be on the top level right next to the Dropbox sharing.

Getting there.... Nice appearance and basic use. Love todo items. I was excited about tags and searching...until I discovered 1Writer doesn't take you to the locations in your doc with the tag or search text. Big hassle for anything over a screen of text.

Loads fast, easy to use and supports inline images. There really isn't a better app out there that is better suited for Markdown notes than 1Writer. Excellent tag support, inline images, great Markdown rendering, PDF export, fast startup time and Dropbox + iCloud integration all make this the best Markdown editor ever.
Versatile. This has taken over as my primary word editing and sorting app! Great job.
